thread:
Nina (Support): P1 from trial account acerohealth.dev — embeddings failing across 3 tenant namespaces, onboarding blocked. Error spikes started ~20m ago, overall success rate ~40% for embeddings. Can CS own comms?
Sam (CS): On it. Do we have a quick mitigation and ETA? I can prep a short proactive note and bridge.
Nina (Support): Quick details: requests to /v1/embeddings returning 502 and occasional 429. Tried restart of gateway, flush of prefix cache, and failover to backup model; failures persisted. Example log: `ERROR inference-gateway: 502 upstream fetch failed for model redwood-embed-5; trace=e7f9c`
OpsBot: [alert] customer=acerohealth.dev severity=high incidents=INC-7890,INC-7891
Diego (SRE): Likely saturation + a transient auth token rotation hitting a subset of tenants. I can spin up standby embed pool. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-pool-standby --replicas=3` then update routes.
Nina (Support): Attempted route change to quantized-embed-4 but gateway rejected with model-compat error. Also seeing `{"error":"token_mismatch","code":401}` for two tenants.
Sam (CS): Ok plan: 1) SRE spin standby, 2) Support verify tokens for affected tenants, 3) CS sends proactive note with ETA 60m and bridge invite. Maya, please approve a trial goodwill credit.
Maya (Acct Exec): Approve credit offer for trial friction. Suggest 10% trial extension + credit note in follow-up postmortem message.
Diego (SRE): Standby pool scaled. After routing subset of tenants through standby, one tenant's success rate is now 92%. Two tenants still failing on auth.
Nina (Support): Auth team investigating token mismatch root cause. Temporary workaround: re-issue tenant API tokens via admin console; sample curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` returns 200 for test vectors.
Sam (CS): Draft comms (short):
"Hi <CustomerName>, we observed degraded embedding performance during your trial window affecting a subset of requests. We've applied an interim routing fix and are working to resolve token mismatches for two tenants. We expect full recovery within 60 minutes and will follow up with a postmortem and trial credit. We're available for a quick call if you'd like more detail. — Sam, CS"
Nina (Support): +1. I'll run token re-issuance for affected tenants and confirm. Adding Eng-runtime if tokens don't resolve in 30m.
OpsBot: INC-7890 attached to thread.
Sam (CS): Owners assigned: support/Nina (remediation), SRE/Diego (infra + standby), CS/Sam & Maya (comms + credits). Reconvene in 45m to confirm stability; escalate to Eng-runtime if not resolved.
